name: Whitney Verbeck
public_footprint:
Whitney Verbeck, of North Tonawanda, NY, graduated summa cum laude from SUNY Potsdam in 2022 with a B.A. in Childhood/Early Childhood Education and earned an M.S. in Education (Curriculum and Instruction) in 2024, with multiple President's List honors and induction into the Phi Alpha Theta history honor society.
Sources: https://potsdam.meritpages.com/stories/Whitney-Verbeck-Set-to-Graduate-from-SUNY-Potsdam/82323152; https://potsdam.meritpages.com/stories/Whitney-Verbeck-Set-to-Graduate-from-SUNY-Potsdam/133059463
